title: How Long Does Yogurt Last After Opening?

seo.title: How Long Does Yogurt Last After Opening?
seo.meta_description: Opened yogurt should stay cold and clean. Use the opening date, package condition, and spoilage signs instead of relying on the printed date alone.
seo.search_intent: Determine how long to keep opened yogurt and when time, temperature, or spoilage signs mean it should be discarded.

excerpt: Once yogurt is opened, the factory seal is no longer protecting it. The practical decision combines the opening date, continuous refrigeration, and the actual condition of the yogurt.
content_html:
After opening yogurt, continuous refrigeration and clean serving matter as much as the date printed on the cup. FoodSafety.gov provides general cold-storage guidance, while the manufacturer may give a more specific instruction.

Keep it at 40°F (4°C) or below

Return the yogurt to the refrigerator promptly and close the container. Use a clean spoon; dipping a used spoon back into a large tub introduces extra contamination.

Mark the opening date

For family-size containers, a small date on the lid removes guesswork. If you cannot remember when it was opened and it has been sitting for an uncertain number of days, the safest answer may be to discard it.

Some liquid separation is normal

Whey can collect on top and usually stirs back in. Mold, a distinctly foul odor, gas, a swollen package, or an unusual slimy texture are different: discard the yogurt.

Do not taste questionable yogurt as a test

A spoonful is not a safety check. If the product spent too long above safe refrigeration temperature or clearly looks spoiled, throw it out.

Added fruit and homemade yogurt can differ

Follow the product label when it gives a shorter after-opening period. Homemade yogurt or yogurt transferred to another container should go into a clean, dated, covered container.

If the yogurt is within its recommended storage window, stayed cold, and shows no abnormal changes, it is usually reasonable to keep using it. If any of those conditions fail, the margin gets smaller.

faq.question: Does liquid on top mean yogurt is spoiled?
faq.answer: Not by itself. It is often separated whey; also check for mold, off odor, gas, or unusual texture.

faq.question: Can I taste it to see whether it is safe?
faq.answer: Do not use tasting as a safety test if the yogurt was held too warm or shows spoilage.

faq.question: Does using a clean spoon matter?
faq.answer: Yes. It reduces the amount of outside contamination introduced into the container.
